statement: CouchTurtle reports that on a physical Puck receiver path, lizard input reports 0x40/0x41 resumed within about eight seconds of terminating Steam on 2026-05-19. The published test does not rule out hid-steam client-close registration 0x85/0x8e restoring lizard; therefore it measures a post-Steam-exit restoration outcome, not an isolated autonomous retail firmware watchdog. The Puck result cannot set the default timer of the distinct wired 28de:1302 emulator. SDL 3s, OpenPuck 7s and sc26re 10s are separate host/firmware policies.
